    <script type="text/javascript">

// makes it possible for a referred page to refresh on 'back' button pressed
        window.onbeforeunload = function() {
    window.name = "reloader";
        };

        $(document).ready(function () {
            switch('web50windowssoftware') {
                case 'web50windowssoftware':
                    $("#navigationLeft a.windowsreport").addClass("active");
                    break;
                case 'web50linuxsoftwaretotal':
                    $("#navigationLeft a.linuxreport").addClass("active");
                    break;
                case 'web50macsoftwaretotal':
                    $("#navigationLeft a.macreport").addClass("active");
                    break;
                case 'web50scannedlicensekeys':
                    $("#navigationLeft a.licensereport").addClass("active");
                    break;
                case 'web50scannedos':
                    $("#navigationLeft a.osreport").addClass("active");
                    break;
                case 'web50scannedqlservers':
                    $("#navigationLeft a.sqlreport").addClass("active");
                    break;
                case 'web50scannedantivirus':
                    $("#navigationLeft a.antivirusreport").addClass("active");
                    break;
            }

            window.firstrun = true;
            $("#reptitle div:first-child").hide();
            $("#reptitle div").css("top",$(".grtop").height());

            

            Getreport();
        
            $(window).scroll(function () {
                $('#newheadwrap').css({ 'left': 0 - $(this).scrollLeft() });
                $('.menuleft').css({ 'left': 0 - $(this).scrollLeft() });
                $('#reptitle').css({ 'left': 0 - $(this).scrollLeft() });
            });
            $(window).resize(function () {
                adjustheader();

            });

            //#curpage
            $("#pagesize").on("change", function (event) {
                $("#curpage").text("1");
                Getreport();
            });
            $("#nextp").on("click", function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                if ($("#nextp").hasClass("disabled")) return;
                $("#curpage").text(parseInt($("#curpage").text()) + 1);
                Getreport();
            });
            $("#prevp").on("click", function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                if (parseInt($("#curpage").text()) == 1) return;
                $("#curpage").text(parseInt($("#curpage").text()) - 1);
                Getreport();
            });
            $(document).on("keyup",".filtercol" , function (event) {
                //clear current page
            
                clearTimeout(window.timeout);
                window.timeout = setTimeout(function () {  $("#curpage").text("1");Getreport(); }, 1500);
            });
            $(document).on("click", "#reptable thead tr:first th:not(:last-child)", function (event) {
            
                var d = $(this);
                if (d.hasClass("sorting_asc") || (!d.hasClass("sorting_asc") && !d.hasClass("sorting_desc"))) {
                    $("#reptable th").removeClass("sorting_desc");
                    $("#reptable th").removeClass("sorting_asc");
                    d.addClass("sorting_desc");
                    window.sortdir = "desc";
                }
                else {
                    $("#reptable th").removeClass("sorting_desc");
                    $("#reptable th").removeClass("sorting_asc");
                    d.addClass("sorting_asc");
                    window.sortdir = "asc";
                }
                $("#curpage").text("1");
            
                if(!d.hasClass("colpingth")) Getreport();
                else sortping(d.hasClass("sorting_desc") &&  !$('#pinglink').hasClass("disabled"));
            });

            //sidebalk functions
            $(".clickrescan").on("click", function (event) {
                //rescan report
                

                event.preventDefault();
                if ($('#reptable tbody tr:not(.reporterror)').length > 0) {
                    
                
                    var url = $(this).attr('href');
                    $('#reptablefixedhead thead tr:nth-child(2) th').each(function() {
                        if($(this).find('input').length > 0 && $(this).find('input').val() != '') {
                            url += '&' + $(this).find('input').attr('id').toLowerCase() + '=' + $(this).find('input').val();
                        }
                    });
                    var cl = $(this).clone();
                    cl.attr('href', url);
                    askrescanrep(cl.get(0));
                    
                }
                else CustomAlert('No assets in the list.', 'Info', 'info');
            }); 
            $(".clickwol").on("click", function (event) {
                //rescan report
                event.preventDefault();
                if ($('#reptable tbody tr:not(.reporterror)').length > 0) {
                    var url = $(this).attr('href');
                    $('#reptablefixedhead thead tr:nth-child(2) th').each(function() {
                        if($(this).find('input').length > 0 && $(this).find('input').val() != '') {
                            url += '&' + $(this).find('input').attr('id').toLowerCase() + '=' + $(this).find('input').val();
                        }
                    });
                    var cl = $(this).clone();
                    cl.attr('href', url);
                    askrescanwol(cl.get(0));
                }
                else CustomAlert('No assets in the list.', 'Info', 'info');
            }); 

//            
        });

    //if rev = true -> just reverse rows
        function sortping(rev) {
            var tr = $("#reptable tbody tr");
            $("#reptable tbody tr").remove();
            if(rev) {
                //if reverse
                $.fn.reverse = [].reverse;
                $("#reptable").append(tr.reverse());

            } else {
                //if no reverse
                $("#reptable").append(tr.get().sort(function(a, b) {
                 
                    switch ($(a).children().first().children().first().attr("src")) {
                    case "/images/nok.png":
                        a = 2;  
                        break;
                    case "/images/ok.png":
                        a = 1;
                        break;
                    default:
                        a = 3;
                        break;
                    }
                    switch ($(b).children().first().children().first().attr("src")) {
                    case "/images/nok.png":
                        b = 2;  
                        break;
                    case "/images/ok.png":
                        b = 1;
                        break;
                    default:
                        b = 3;
                        break;
                    }
                    return parseInt(a) - parseInt(b);
                    //return (($(a).children().first().children().first().attr("src").indexOf("nok.png") != -1)  < ($(b).children().first().children().first().attr("src").indexOf("nok.png") != -1 ))?-1:1;
                }));
            
            }
        }

        function Getreport(allowCache, loadscreen) {
            if(loadscreen == undefined || loadscreen == true) {
                ShowLoading();
            }

            //scroll to top
            try {
                $(window).scrollTop(0);
            }catch(e){}
        

            //clear all ajax requests and reset ping
            if(window.xhr != undefined){
                $(window.xhr).each(function() {
                    this.abort();
                });
                window.xhr = undefined;
           
                $('#indi').css("display", "none");
                $('#pinglink').attr("href", "javascript:pingassets()");
                $('#pinglink').removeClass("disabled");
                $(".filtercol").removeAttr("disabled");
            }

            var page = parseInt($("#curpage").text());
            var top = parseInt($("#pagesize").val());

            if (page == 1) $("#prevp").addClass("disabled");
            else $("#prevp").removeClass("disabled");


            //search fields
            var search = new Object();
            $("#reptable thead tr input").each(function() {
                if(this.value != "") {
                    // search += ("&" + this.id + "=" + this.value);
                    search[this.id] = this.value;
                }
            });
            //get sort
            var sort = "";
            var th = $("#reptable thead tr:first");
            if(th.find("th.sorting_asc").length == 1) {
                if (th.find("th.sorting_asc").text() != "") sort = "&order=asc&orderby=" + encodeURIComponent(th.find("th.sorting_asc").attr('data-actualTitle'));
            } else if (th.find("th.sorting_desc").length == 1) {
                if (th.find("th.sorting_desc").text() != "") sort = "&order=desc&orderby=" + encodeURIComponent(th.find("th.sorting_desc").attr('data-actualTitle'));
            }

            var cache = "&cache=1";
            if (window.firstrun ||  window.refresh || allowCache == false ) cache = "&cache=0";


            var url = "/ReportJson.aspx?det=web50windowssoftware&top=" + top + "&page=" + page + sort+cache;
      

            if(window.xhr != undefined){
                $(window.xhr).each(function() {
                    this.abort();
                });
                window.xhr = new Array();	
            }else {window.xhr = new Array();}

           
            var t = $.post(url, search, function(data, textStatus) {

            var columnsCounter = new Array();
            var allNewNames = new Array();
            var columnsNameCounter = new Object();
            var dataCounter = 0;

                //FIRST time: create header + set options
                if (window.firstrun) {
                    window.hasassetid = -1;
                    window.hasthestate = -1;
                    window.backgroundcolor = -1;
                    window.foregroundcolor = -1;
                    window.hasos = -1;
                    window.hasicon = false;
                    var head = "<tr><th></th>";


                    for (var i = 0; i < data.Columns.length; i++) {
                        var columnTitle = data.Columns[i];
                        if (reportColumnRenames[columnTitle] !== undefined) {
                            columnTitle = reportColumnRenames[columnTitle];
                        }

                        if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() == "icon") window.hasicon = true;
                        else if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() == "icon2" || data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() == "icon3") head += ("<th style='min-width: 0px;'></th>");
                        else if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() == "deviceassetid") head += "";
                        else if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() == "assetidvpc") head += "";
                        else if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() == "foregroundcolor") window.foregroundcolor = i;
                        else if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() == "backgroundcolor") window.backgroundcolor = i;
                        else if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() == "assetid") window.hasassetid = i;
                        else if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() == "thestate") window.hasthestate = i;
                        else if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() == "os") {
                            window.hasos = i;
                       
                            head += ("<th style='min-width: " + 0 + "px;' data-actualTitle='" + data.Columns[i] + "'>" + columnTitle + "</th>");
                        } else if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() != "picture" && data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() != "assetid" && data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() != "foregroundcolor" && data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() != "backgroundcolor" && data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() != "reportquery" && data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() != "thestate" && data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() != "packageid" && data.Columns[i].toLowerCase().indexOf("hyperlink_name_") != 0) {
                        
                            
                            
                            head += ("<th style='min-width: 0px;' data-actualTitle='" + data.Columns[i] + "'>" + columnTitle + "</th>");
                            
                        
                        }else if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase() == "picture")
                            head += ("<th data-actualTitle='" + data.Columns[i] + "'>" + columnTitle + "</th>");

                    
                        if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase().indexOf("hyperlink_") == 0 && data.Columns[i].toLowerCase().indexOf("hyperlink_name_") != 0) {
                            columnsCounter.push(i);
                        }

                        if (data.Columns[i].toLowerCase().indexOf("hyperlink_name_") == 0) {
                            if(data.AddedRows[i] != undefined){
                                columnsNameCounter[dataCounter] = data.AddedRows[0][i];   
                                dataCounter++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    var arrayCounter = 0;
                    for (var da = 0; da < data.AddedRows.length; da++) {
                        for (var cc = 0; cc < columnsCounter.length; cc++) {
                            allNewNames[arrayCounter] = data.AddedRows[da][columnsCounter[cc]+1];
                            arrayCounter++;
                        }

                    }
                    
                    
                    head += "<th style='width: 100%;'></th></tr><tr><th></th>";
                    
                

                    for (var f = 0; f < data.Columns.length; f++) {
                        if (data.Columns[f].toLowerCase() == "icon" || data.Columns[f].toLowerCase() == "deviceassetid" || data.Columns[f].toLowerCase() == "assetidvpc") {
                            head += "";
                        }
                        else if (data.Columns[f].toLowerCase() == "icon2" || data.Columns[f].toLowerCase() == "icon3") {
                            head += "<th></th>";
                        }
                        else if (data.Columns[f].toLowerCase() != "assetid" && data.Columns[f].toLowerCase() != "reportquery" && data.Columns[f].toLowerCase() != "thestate" && data.Columns[f].toLowerCase() != "foregroundcolor" && data.Columns[f].toLowerCase() != "backgroundcolor" && data.Columns[f].toLowerCase() != "packageid" && data.Columns[f].toLowerCase().indexOf("hyperlink_name_") != 0) {
                            head += ("<th><input type='text' class='filtercol reportsearchfield stylish' id='" + data.Columns[f] + "' ></th>");
                        }
                    }

                    
                    head += "<th style='width: 100%;'></th></tr>";
                    
                
                    $("#reptable").prepend("<thead>" + head + "</thead>");

                    //Create fixed head
                    CreateFixedhead();

                    $('#reptablewrapper').css('margin-top', $('#softwareNormalizationInfoBlock').length > 0 ? '100px' : '28px');
                    if ($('#softwareNormalizationInfoBlock').length > 0) {
                        $('#newheadwrap').css('border-top', '1px solid #B6B6B6');
                    }

                    window.firstrun = false;

                    //edit left column, show right links
                    if (window.hasassetid != -1) {
                        
                            $("#pinglink").parent().show();
                            $(".clickrescan").parent().show();
                            $(".clickwol").parent().show();
                        
                        
                        if('True' == "True") {
                            $(".deploymentMenu").show();    
                        }
                    }
                }
                //reset ping column
                if ($("td.colping").length != 0) $("th.colpingth").remove();

                //create body
                var body = "";
                var teller = 0;
                var nameCounter = 0;
                for (var j = 0; j < data.AddedRows.length; j++) {
                    teller++;
                                
                    var trattrs = "";
                    //if assetid -> set tr.id 
                    if (window.hasassetid != -1) trattrs += ("id='" + data.AddedRows[j][window.hasassetid] + "' ");
                    

                    if (/*data.AddedRows[j][window.hasos] == "Not scanned" || */(window.foregroundcolor != -1 && data.AddedRows[j][window.foregroundcolor].toString() === 'red')) trattrs += " class='rred'";
                    else if (window.hasthestate != -1 && data.AddedRows[j][window.hasthestate] != 1) trattrs += " class='lgr'";


                    body += "<tr ";
                
                    if ((window.backgroundcolor != -1) || (window.foregroundcolor != -1)) {
                        body += " style='";
                    
                        if (window.backgroundcolor != -1) {
                            body += "background-color:" + data.AddedRows[j][window.backgroundcolor].toString() + ";"; 
                        }
                        if (window.foregroundcolor != -1) {
                            body += "color:" + data.AddedRows[j][window.foregroundcolor].toString() + ";";  
                        }
                        body += "'";

                    }
               
                    body += trattrs;
                    if(teller % 2 != 0) body += ' class="uneven"';
                    body += ">";
                
                     
                    if (!window.hasicon) body += "<td><img width='10' height='10' src='/images/repsm.gif' style='margin-top:2px;margin-bottom:2px;'></td>";
                    
                
                var contentWritten;

                    for (var k = 0; k < data.Columns.length; k++) {
                        if (data.Columns[k].toLowerCase().indexOf("hyperlink_name_") != 0 && data.Columns[k].toLowerCase() != "assetid" && data.Columns[k].toLowerCase() != "reportquery" && data.Columns[k].toLowerCase() != "foregroundcolor" && data.Columns[k].toLowerCase() != "backgroundcolor" && data.Columns[k].toLowerCase() != "thestate" && data.Columns[k].toLowerCase() != "deviceassetid" && data.Columns[k].toLowerCase() != "assetidvpc" && data.Columns[k].toLowerCase() != "packageid") {
                            contentWritten = false;
                            for (var vv = 0; vv < columnsCounter.length; vv++) {
                                if (k == columnsCounter[vv]) {
                                    body += ('<td><span style="white-space: nowrap;"><a href="' + data.AddedRows[j][k] + '" target="_blanc">'+ allNewNames[nameCounter] +'</a></span></td>');
                                    contentWritten = true;
                                    nameCounter++;
                                }
                            }

                            if (!contentWritten) {
                                body += ('<td><span style="white-space: nowrap;">' + data.AddedRows[j][k] + '</span></td>');
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    
                    body += "<td></td></tr>";
               
               
                }
                $("#reptable tbody tr").remove();
                $("#reptable tbody").html(body);


                //calc total
                var total = parseInt(data.Emsg);
                $('#reptable').attr('rel', total);
                var lastpage = $("#pagesize").val() * page;
                if (lastpage > total) lastpage = total;
                if (total <= $("#pagesize").val()) $("#totalassets").text(total);
                else $("#totalassets").text((((page - 1) * $("#pagesize").val()) + 1) + "-" + lastpage + "/" + total);

                //if no paging
                if (total < 250) $("#reptitle div").hide();
                if (total < $("#pagesize").val()) { $("#reptitle div").show(); $("#reptitle div#pagingButtonsDiv").hide(); }
                else $("#reptitle div").show();
            
            
                //disable next page 
                if (page * $("#pagesize").val() >= total) $("#nextp").addClass("disabled");
                else $("#nextp").removeClass("disabled");

                //align numeric right
                $('#reptable tbody tr td').filter(function() {
                    return this.innerHTML.match( /^[0-9\s\,]+$/ );
                }).css('text-align', 'right');
                
                //if no rows, display error
                if (data.AddedRows.length == 0) {
                    body = "<tr class='reporterror' style='color: #ff0000;'>";
                    body += "<td><img width='10' height='10' src='/images/warning.gif' style='margin-top:2px;margin-bottom:2px' valign='top' /></td>";
                    body += "<td style='width:100%' colspan='" + (data.Columns.length) + "'>This report has no results!</td>";
                    body += "</tr>";
                    $("#reptable tbody tr").remove();
                    $("#reptable tbody").html(body);
                
                }
                if (data.Error) {
                    body = "<tr class='reporterror' style='color: #ff0000;'>";
                    body += "<td><img width='10' height='10' src='/images/warning.gif' style='margin-top:2px;margin-bottom:2px' valign='top' /></td>";
                    body += "<td style='width:100%' colspan='" + (data.Columns.length)+ "'>Error: " + data.Emsg + "</td>";
                    body += "</tr>";
                    $("#reptable tbody tr").remove();
                    $("#reptable tbody").html(body);
                    $("#reptitle div").hide();
                    $("#totalassets").text("0");
                    $("#newheadwrap").hide();
                    $("#reptable thead").hide();
                }

            changeCulumnNames('reptable');
            changeCulumnNames('reptablefixedhead');

            //adjust header sizes
            adjustheader();

            //remove hh:mm:ss if they're 00:00:00
            var tempVar;
            $("#reptable tbody tr td").each(function() {
                tempVar = $(this).text();
                if (tempVar.indexOf("00:00:00") > 0) {
                    tempVar = tempVar.replace("00:00:00","");
                    $(this).text(tempVar);
                }
            });
            if(loadscreen == undefined || loadscreen == true){
                HideLoading();
            }
            

            }, "json");
            window.xhr.push(t);
    }

            $("#loadingDialog").show();
            $("#loadingDialog2").show();
        }

            $("#loadingDialog").hide();
            $("#loadingDialog2").hide();
        }

        }
   
        function pingassets() {
            if ($('#reptable tbody tr:not(.reporterror)').length > 0) {
                $('#pinglink').attr("href", "#");
                $('#pinglink').addClass("disabled");
                $(".filtercol").attr("disabled", "disabled");

                var firsttime = false;

                if ($(".colping").length == 0) {
                    //head
                    $("#reptable thead tr:nth-child(1)").prepend("<th class='colpingth' style='padding:2px;'></th>");
                    $("#reptable thead tr:nth-child(2)").prepend("<th class='colpingth' style='padding:2px;'><img width='16' height='16' src='/actions/tester.png' />P</th>");
                    $("#reptablefixedhead thead tr:nth-child(1)").prepend("<th class='colpingth' style='padding:2px;width:15px;'>Ping</th>");
                    $("#reptablefixedhead thead tr:nth-child(2)").prepend("<th class='colpingth' style='padding:2px;width:15px;'><img width='16' height='16' src='/actions/tester.png' /></th>");
                    //Colgroup

                    AdjustLastcolumn();

                    firsttime = true;
                }
                //pingers
                window.pingers =[];
                window.repingers = [];
                $("#reptable tbody tr").each(function (key, value) {
                    if (firsttime) {
                        $(value).prepend("<td class='colping' width='10' style='padding:2px;' valign='top'><img width='10' height='10' style='margin-top:2px' class='pinger' rel='" + $(this).attr("id") + "' src='/images/indicator.gif' name='indi'></td>");
                    }
                
                    if($.inArray($(this).attr("id"), window.pingers) == -1)window.pingers.push($(this).attr("id"));
                 
                });
                $('.colping').css("display", "");

                adjustheader();

                $('.pinger').attr("src", "/images/indicator.gif");
           
                $.ajaxSetup({ cache: false });
                window.pingassets.count = 0;
                window.pingassets.total = $(".pinger").length;
                $(window.pingers).each(function (key, value) {
                    //alert($("#reptable tbody tr#"+value).length);
                    PingAsset($("#reptable tbody tr#"+value +" .pinger"));
                });
            }
            else CustomAlert('No assets in the list.', 'Info', 'info');
        }
        
        function PingAsset(asset) {
            var $asset = $(asset);

            $.ajaxSetup(({ cache: false }));
            
            var t= $.getJSON('/ping.aspx', { assetid: $asset.attr("rel") }, function (data) {
                window.pingassets.count += $asset.length;
                 switch (data.Status) {
                        case 1: //online
                            $($asset).attr("src", "/images/ok.png");
                            break;
                        case 2: //offline
                           $($asset).attr("src", "/images/nok.png");
                            break;
                        case 3: //vproAMT
                            $($asset).attr("src", "/images/orange.png");
                            break;
                        default: //neutral response
                        $($asset).attr("src", "/images/neutral.png"); 
                        }
                $asset.className = $asset.className;//force faster redraw trick
                if (window.pingassets.count == window.pingassets.total) {
                    if(window.repingers.length == 0) {
                        //check if really complete
                        $('#indi').css("display", "none");
                        $('#pinglink').attr("href", "javascript:pingassets()");
                        $('#pinglink').removeClass("disabled");
                        $(".filtercol").removeAttr("disabled");
                        window.pingers = null;
                    }
                    else {
                        window.pingassets.count = window.pingassets.count - window.repingers.length;
                        for(var i = 0; i < window.repingers.length; i++) {
                            PingAsset(window.repingers[i]);
                        }   
                        window.repingers = [];
                    }            
                } 
            }).fail(function() {
                window.pingassets.count += $asset.length;
                repingers.push(asset);
                if (window.pingassets.count == window.pingassets.total) {
                    window.pingassets.count = window.pingassets.count - window.repingers.length;
                        for(var i = 0; i < window.repingers.length; i++) {
                            PingAsset(window.repingers[i]);
                        }
                    window.repingers = [];
                }
            });
        
            if(window.xhr == undefined)window.xhr = new Array();
            window.xhr.push(t);
        }
        jQuery.expr[':'].Contains = function (a, i, m) {
            return (a.textContent || a.innerText || "").toUpperCase().indexOf(m[3].toUpperCase()) >= 0;
        };
        
        function CreateFixedhead() {
            var head = $("#reptable thead").clone();

            var top = calculateNewheadTop();

            var table = $("<div id='newheadwrap' style='border-left: 1px solid #B6B6B6;border-bottom: 1px solid #B6B6B6;position: fixed; width:100%; top:" + top +"px;left:0px; margin-left: 254px;'><table id='reptablefixedhead' class='reptable' style='width: 100%;table-layout:fixed;background: url(\"/images/table_header_gradient_1.png\");' cellspacing='0' cellpadding='0'></table></div>");
            $("#reptablewrapper").before(table);
            $("#reptablefixedhead").html(head);
            

            
           
            $("#reptablefixedhead thead tr:first").on("click","th", function (event) {

              
                var index = ($(this).index()+1);
                
              
                $("#reptable thead tr:first th:nth-child(" + index + ")").trigger("click");
                //sorting icon
                var th = $(this);
                if (th.hasClass("sorting_desc")) {
                    $("#reptablefixedhead th").removeClass("sorting_desc");
                    $("#reptablefixedhead th").removeClass("sorting_asc");
                    th.addClass("sorting_asc");
                } else {
                    $("#reptablefixedhead th").removeClass("sorting_desc");
                    $("#reptablefixedhead th").removeClass("sorting_asc");
                    th.addClass("sorting_desc");
                }
            });


            //search
            $("#reptablefixedhead thead input.filtercol").on("keyup", function (event) {

              
                //copy val
                $("#reptable thead tr:nth-child(2) th:nth-child(" + ($(this).parent().index()+1) + ") input.filtercol").val(this.value);
                //trigger
                $("#reptable thead input.filtercol").trigger("keyup");
            });


        }
        function adjustheader() {
                  
            
            
            $("#reptablefixedhead").css("width", $("#reptable").width() + "px");
            $("#reptitle").css("width", $("#reptable").width() + "px");
            $("#newheadwrap").css("width", $("#reptable").width() + "px");


            $("#reptablefixedhead thead tr:first th:not(:last-child)").each(function (key, obj) {
                var w = $("#reptable thead tr:first th:nth-child(" + (key+1) + ")").width();
                var minw = $("#reptable thead tr:first th:nth-child(" + (key + 1) + ")").css("min-width");
                var ww = $(this).width();
                if(w <  minw) w = minw;
                if(ww>w) w = ww;
                //set min width if not last
                
                if(key != 0) $("#reptable thead tr:first th:nth-child(" + (key + 1) + ")").css("min-width", w+"px");

                $(this).css("width", w + "px");
                // $(this).css("padding", "3px 2px");
            });
        }
        function gettotals() {
            $.ajaxSetup({ cache: false });
            window.totalss = new Array();
            //put all in window array
            $('#reptable tbody tr').each(function () {
                window.totalss.push(this.id);
            });

              
            window.progressbar.progressbar("option", "max", window.totalss.length);
            gettotal();
            //get json status and start next gettotal()
        }

        function gettotal() {
            var id = window.totalss.shift();
            var $report = $("#reptable tbody tr#" + id + " td:nth-child(3)");
            $.ajaxSetup(({ cache: false }));
            $.getJSON('/totalreport.aspx', { report: id }, function (data) {
                  
                var $par = $report.parent();
                // $report.effect("highlight", {}, 1000);
                if (data.Status == '-1') {
                    $($report).html('error');
                    $par.addClass("rred");
                    $par.removeClass("lgr");

                } else {
                    $($report).html(data.Status);
                    $par.removeClass("rred");
                    $par.removeClass("lgr");
                    if (data.Status == '0') {
                        $par.addClass("lgr");
                    }
                }
                //effect
                window.progressbar.progressbar("value", (window.progressbar.progressbar("option", "max" ) -window.totalss.length) );
                $report.hide().fadeIn();
                if(window.totalss.length > 0) setTimeout(gettotal,500);//continue loop
                else {
                    window.progressbar.progressbar("destroy"); //hide progressbar
                    $("#totalprogress").hide();
                }
            });

        }

        function redirectToExport(id, hyperlink) {
            //no export to xls if total > 65536
            if (id == 'exportxls' && parseInt($('#reptable').attr('rel')) > 1048576)
                    CustomAlert("This report is too large for a xlsx file. Please export as .csv or .xml ", "Error", "error");
            else {
                var url = hyperlink;
                var asccol = $("#reptable thead tr:first").find("th.sorting_asc").text();
                var desccol = $("#reptable thead tr:first").find("th.sorting_desc").text();
                url += '&orderby=' + (asccol == '' ? desccol.toLowerCase() : asccol.toLowerCase());
                if ($("#reptable thead tr:first").find("th.sorting_asc").length == 1) url += '&order=asc';
                else if ($("#reptable thead tr:first").find("th.sorting_desc").length == 1) url += '&order=desc';
                $('#reptablefixedhead thead tr:nth-child(2) th').each(function() {
                    if ($(this).find('input').length > 0 && $(this).find('input').val() != '') {
                        url += '&[' + $(this).find('input').attr('id').toLowerCase() + ']=' + $(this).find('input').val();
                    }
                });
                window.location = url;
            }
        };

        $(document).on('click', '.exportlink', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            var element = $(this);

            $.post('/Export.aspx?action=checkIsAllowed', function (data) {
                data = JSON.parse(data);
                if (data.Error) {
                    CustomAlert(data.Emsg, 'Error', 'error');
                }
                else {
                    if (!data.ReturnValues.IsAllowed) {
                        CustomAlert(data.ReturnValues.Message, 'Exporting not allowed', 'warning');
                    }
                    else {
                        redirectToExport(element.attr('id'), element.attr('href'));
                    }
                }
            })
        });

        $(document).on("click", ".executeNow", function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
                if("True".toLowerCase() == "true"){
                    var filters = new Object();
                    $("#reptablefixedhead .reportsearchfield").each(function() {
                        if(this.value != "") {
                            filters[this.id] = this.value;
                        }
                    });
                    var filtersJSON = JSON.stringify(filters);
                
                    StandardDialog("/deployment/ScheduleActions.aspx?action=addConfig&report=web50windowssoftware&source=report&params=&filters="+encodeURIComponent(filtersJSON), "Deploy", function (data) {
                        var r = $.parseJSON(data);
                        if (r.Error) {
                            $(".ui-dialog-buttonpane .verror").remove();
                            $(".ui-dialog-buttonpane").prepend("<div style='float: left;' class='verror' data-cy='errormessage'>  <span class='rred'>Error while saving:<br /> " + r.Emsg + "</span><br></div>");
                            return false;
                        } else {
                            return true;
                        }
                    },undefined, undefined, "Are you sure you want to deploy this package?");
                
                }else{
                    CustomAlert("Provide an account with read-execute rights only on the shared folder.<br/>Using an administrator account is a severe security risk!<br/>This password will be accessible to all users. Click <a href='/deployment/packageshares.aspx'>here</a> to enter the details.","Warning","warning");
                }
        });

        function calculateNewheadTop() {
            var top = $('#TopBar').height();
            top += ($("div#reptitle").height() + 13);
            if ($('#softwareNormalizationInfoBlock').length > 0) {
                top += 67;
            }
            return top;
        }

        function removeReportInfoBlock() {
            $('#reptablewrapper').css('margin-top', '28px');
            $('#newheadwrap').css({ 'border-top': 'none', 'top': calculateNewheadTop() + 'px' });
        }

<script type="text/javascript">
    var licenseIsFilledIn = true;
    var hasRights = '1';

    $(document).ready(function () {
        licenseIsFilledIn = getIsLicenseFilledIn();
        if (hasRights === '0' && !licenseIsFilledIn) {
            $("#emailCaptureOverlay").show();
            $('#emailCaptureModal_screen2').hide();
            $('#btnSubmitKey').hide();
            $('.errorBlock').hide();
            $('.errorBlock').next().hide();
            $('#emailSubmitContainer_screen4').show();
            $('#emailCaptureModal_screen4').show();
            $("#emailCaptureModal").css({ "min-height": "300px" });
            $("#emailCaptureOverlay").show();
            if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
                $('#firstrunOverlay').hide();
            }
        } else {
            if (!licenseIsFilledIn) {
                initiateUnlockArea($('#keyArea'), isValidLicense);
                if (!(typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun)) {
                    $("#emailCaptureOverlay").show();
                    if (!doesConnectionExist()) {
                        $('#emailSubmitContainer_screen2').show();
                        $('#emailSubmitContainer_screen1').hide();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        //dirty fix for jquery ui focus stealing bug
        if (window.jQuery && window.jQuery.ui.dialog) {
            setTimeout(function() {
                $(document).unbind("focusin.dialog");
            }, 500);
        }
    });

    $(document).on('click', '.submitKey', function(e) {
        // if valid license, remove overlay
        var license = $(this).parent().find('.keyArea').val();
        var container = $(this).parents("div").first();
        var errorBlock = container.find(".errorBlock");

        if (unlocked) {
            openActivationTab(activationUrl);
        }

        if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
            ShowLoading();
        }
        
        var valid = checkIsValidLicense(license, errorBlock);

        if (valid) {
            saveLicense(license);

            //Open tab when activationUrl is available
            licenseIsFilledIn = true;

            if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
                firstRunNextContinue();
            }
            else {
                location.reload();
            }
        }
        else {
            $(this).parent().find('fieldset').css('border-color', '#ff0000');
            $(this).parent().find('.keyArea').css('color', '#ff0000');
        }
        if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
            HideLoading();
        }
    });

    $(document).on('click', '#btnContinue', function (e) {
        // remove overlay and continue the first run wizard
        $("#emailCaptureOverlay").remove();
        if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
            location.reload();
        }
    });

    $(document).on('click', '#btnBackToLoginKey', function (e) {
        location.href = "/login.aspx?lo=1";
    });

    $(document).on('paste', '#keyArea', function () {
        $('.errorBlock').html('');
    });

    function doesConnectionExist() {
        var url = "https://lansweeper.azure-api.net/ls-instances/unlock";
        var success = false;
        $.ajax({
            type: 'GET',
            url: url,
            complete: function (response) {
                if (response.status !== 503 && response.status !== 0){ success = true;}
            },
            async: false
        });
        return success;
    }
</script>
